verified_facts.text: The hotel occupies the 40th to 45th floors of the Tokyo Midtown Yaesu skyscraper.
verified_facts.excerpt: Occupying the 40th to 45th floors of the Tokyo Midtown Yaesu skyscraper

verified_facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the Imperial Palace and the shopping areas of Nihombashi and Ginza.
verified_facts.excerpt: at a walking distance to some of the best attractions in town such as the Imperial Palace and the vibrant shopping areas of both Nihombashi and Ginza

verified_facts.text: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito is on the 40th floor and serves contemporary Italian cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: is located on the 40th floor of the Hotel

verified_facts.text: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito has indoor and outdoor seating.
verified_facts.excerpt: seats up to 62 indoors and 34 outdoors

verified_facts.text: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito combines Japanese design elements such as a curved wood ceiling with a classic Niko Romito Italian menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: Though the space incorporates Japanese design elements like the curved wood ceiling, the menu is classic Niko Romito

verified_facts.text: Sushi Hoseki is a traditional omakase restaurant with 8 seats overlooking a small zen garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: With just 8 seats, it is an impeccably-designed space that looks out onto a tiny zen garden.

verified_facts.text: The 40th-floor Bvlgari Lounge has a large cast iron and granite fireplace and opens onto the Terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a huge cast iron-and-granite fireplace as its centrepiece, the 40th-floor Bvlgari Lounge is a richly textured aerie

verified_facts.text: The Bvlgari Spa is on the 40th floor and its indoor pool is set against floor to ceiling glass windows with views of the skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 25-metre indoor pool is ensconced in floor to ceiling glass windows, giving guests a breathtaking view of the skyline.

verified_facts.text: The Spa Suite has a hydro massage tub clad in Iranian green onyx and treatment beds for two.
verified_facts.excerpt: a Spa Suite, complete with a hydro massage tub cladded in Iranian green onyx and treatment beds for two

verified_facts.text: The changing rooms have hot baths and Japanese showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Male and female changing rooms feature hot baths and Japanese showers for a touch of local culture.

verified_facts.text: Augustinus Bader products and wellness philosophy are available at The Bvlgari Spa.
The spa pool is open to children aged four and above in the daytime window, while the Spa and Fitness Center are for guests aged 16 and above.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Pool is open to children ages four and above; the Bvlgari Spa and Fitness Center are open to those ages 16 and above.

verified_facts.text: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito admits guests aged 12 and above, except staying guests of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests must be ages 12 and above, with the exception of Bvlgari Hotel Tokyo staying guests

verified_facts.text: The Superior Rooms combine vintage Bvlgari ads and silver Bvlgari candleholders with traditional Japanese design elements.
verified_facts.excerpt: Vintage Bvlgari ads and silver Bvlgari candleholders layer with traditional Japanese design elements.

verified_facts.text: The Superior Suites feature decor from Italian brands such as Maxalto and B&B and Japanese wood furniture maker Ritzwell.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring décor from Italian brands such as Maxalto and B&B and Japanese wood furniture maker Ritzwell

verified_facts.text: The Bvlgari Suite layers a modern Italian aesthetic with touches of Japanese tradition.
verified_facts.excerpt: A modern Italian aesthetic is layered with touches of Japanese tradition

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers packing and unpacking services, and can arrange a barber, a tailor or a shoeshine through a partnership with Maison Berluti.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Hotel offers packing and unpacking services tailored to each guest

verified_facts.text: Bvlgari Hotel Tokyo was awarded Three MICHELIN Keys in the 2026 MICHELIN Key Hotels, for the third consecutive year.
verified_facts.excerpt: for the third consecutive year, Bvlgari Hotel Tokyo has been awarded Three Keys

verified_facts.text: The Bvlgari Bar is a rooftop where the hotel serves Pier Daniele Seu pizza.
verified_facts.excerpt: served in the dynamic setting of Tokyo's most dazzling rooftop, The Bvlgari Bar
